title: PAR-20/7G.3 VisualStyle key and OBJECTS identity closure
scope: Audit the generated two-style VisualStyle graph for unique root and child dictionary keys.
Require one ACAD_VISUALSTYLE root key, one entry per expected named style, owner-0 NOD identity, and unique OBJECTS handles.
Retain existing ASCII/Binary typed/raw, owner, reference-remap, and source-order controls.

sourceChange.change: The VisualStyle round-trip now counts the ACAD_VISUALSTYLE root key and each expected named child key, checks owner zero for the actual NOD, and rejects missing or duplicate OBJECTS handles.
sourceChange.reason: Presence-only root/name lookups and expected-record position checks did not establish root-key cardinality or section-wide object identity uniqueness.
